name: Jake Wujastyk
zh_summary: $SPCX：SpaceX鎖定Anthropic自12月起每月支付31億美元計算費用，每年370億美元，至2029年共1205億美元。約佔Anthropic當前收入的80%，大於與Google及Amazon的長期交易。Anthropic警告短期計算成本較高並將壓縮營業利潤率。
en_summary: $SPCX: SpaceX locked Anthropic into paying $3.1 billion per month for compute starting December, $37B a year or $120.5 billion through 2029. About 80% of Anthropic's current revenue would go to SpaceX compute bill, bigger than Google and Amazon deals. Anthropic warns short-term compute carries higher cost and will compress operating margin.
